reason: The README clearly describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin whose primary purpose is subagent orchestration, extending delegation tools with per-call working-directory and composition controls; installation applies provider patches and may modify local preset configuration.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供支持工作目录、模型、提供商、角色、预设和工具过滤器按调用配置的前台与后台子代理委派工具。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with foreground and background subagent delegation tools supporting per-call working-directory, model, provider, persona, preset, and tool-filter settings.
